tools.name: wizzair_search_flight_dates
tools.description: Dates with available Wizzair flights on a route within a from/to window — the fastest way to see which days a route operates before asking for prices. Data comes live from Wizzair's private booking API (unofficial — may briefly fail if Wizzair rotates or throttles it).

tools.name: wizzair_search_timetable
tools.description: Wizzair daily prices AND all departure times on a route in a from/to window (outbound leg): per day you get the price in the route's local currency plus each departure datetime. Data comes live from Wizzair's private booking API (unofficial — may briefly fail if Wizzair rotates or throttles it).

tools.name: wizzair_search_flights
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: detailed Wizzair flights for exact dates with fare bundles (Basic/WIZZ Go/WIZZ Plus — base, discounted and WDC price per bundle, flight numbers, exact times).
